title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线不是某个新模型，而是 AI 正在从工具变成工作系统：公司由 agent 帮你启动，软件团队变成工厂，数据也要从单次任务跟到完整岗位。与此同时，安全问题开始贴近家人和基础设施，真正的瓶颈则提醒我们仍在物理世界里。

archive.title: 工作系统日报
archive.desc: AI agent 正从单次任务进入完整工作流，软件工厂、数据跟踪与物理基础设施同时成为新的瓶颈。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-20 source feeds.

sections.title: From Tasks to Operating Systems / 从任务到工作系统
sections.desc: agent 不再只是替你完成一个动作，而是在接管一整套工作方式。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch argues that a company's genesis is the agent that helps build it. The implication is bigger than a productivity boost: the founding process itself may become an agent-assisted system.
original: A company’s genesis is the agent that helps you build the company

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为，一家公司的起点，就是那个帮助你把公司造出来的 agent。重点不只是效率提升，而是创业过程本身可能会变成一套 agent 参与的工作系统。
original: 一家公司的起点，就是那个帮助你把公司造出来的 agent。

rewrite: Aditya Agarwal points to RoleCUA from Fig as a response to the shift from single tasks to whole jobs. It maps expert roles across months of real work, tying every action to the task and objective it serves. The question is no longer just what an agent can do, but what context should follow the job.
original: Agents are moving from single tasks to whole jobs, and the data has to follow.

rewrite: Aditya Agarwal 用 Fig 的 RoleCUA 说明了一个变化：agent 正从单次任务走向完整岗位。它把专家角色跨数月的真实工作映射出来，并把每个动作和对应的任务、目标连在一起。关键问题不再只是 agent 能做什么，而是工作上下文该如何跟着岗位走。
original: agent 正从单次任务走向完整岗位，数据也必须跟上。

sections.title: Software Factories / 软件工厂
sections.desc: 当代码成为 AI 最成熟的应用场景，工程师的价值开始向结果、反馈和系统设计集中。

rewrite: Rauch's deliberately provocative math says an outcome-oriented creative engineer can become a 1000x engineer, while an engineer lost in tabs-versus-spaces debates can become negative leverage. His broader claim: coding is AI's number-one killer app, and software factories will consume exponentially more tokens.
original: An outcome-oriented, creative engineer is now a 1000x engineer.
If there’s a takeaway from Anthropic’s success, it’s that coding is the #1 killer app of AI.

rewrite: Rauch 的这套粗略算法故意很挑衅：面向结果、富有创造力的工程师，可能变成 1000x 工程师；沉迷 tabs 和 spaces 争论的人，则可能变成负杠杆。更大的判断是，coding 仍是 AI 的头号杀手级应用，软件工厂会消耗指数级增长的 token。
original: 面向结果、富有创造力的工程师，现在可能是 1000x 工程师。
coding 是 AI 的头号杀手级应用。

rewrite: Rauch describes Vercel's Board as infrastructure: a headless Slack for agents, with a purpose-built factory interface for each use case. Some internal factories are TUIs or mostly managed through a Slack agent; people focus on outcomes and feedback. He compares the Board to the Redux state manager of agents.
original: You can generate and deploy the ideal "factory interface" for each usecase.
The board is like the Redux state manager of your agents. It's foundational.

rewrite: Rauch 把 Vercel 的 Board 定义成基础设施：它像是给 agent 用的 headless Slack，每种场景都可以生成自己的工厂界面。有些内部工厂只是 TUI，或主要通过 Slack agent 管理，人只盯结果和反馈。他把 Board 比作 agent 的 Redux state manager。
original: 可以为每个场景生成并部署理想的‘工厂界面’。
Board 就像 agent 的 Redux state manager，是基础设施。

sections.title: Product Surfaces Are Moving / 产品界面正在重做
sections.desc: 模型能力之外，真正影响使用频率的仍是入口、反馈和发布节奏。

rewrite: OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT team member Thibault Sottiaux says a new ChatGPT mobile experience is rolling out to Pro users. The redesign gives the user's dot its own tab and lets people pin Codex, Projects, Images, and other features, with an on/off setting while feedback is collected.
original: We’re also working on a new mobile experience for ChatGPT! It’s easier to get to your favorite features and discover what you can do in ChatGPT.

rewrite: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队成员 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，新的 ChatGPT 移动端体验正在向 Pro 用户 rollout。新版把用户的 dot 单独放进一个 tab，还可以把 Codex、Projects、Images 等功能固定到 tab bar，并允许随时开关，先收集反馈。
original: 我们也在开发全新的 ChatGPT 移动端体验，更容易找到常用功能，也更容易发现 ChatGPT 能做什么。

rewrite: Google VP Josh Woodward announces that Gemini on Mac can now perform tasks on your computer, a feature users had repeatedly requested. The shift is from answering inside the app to acting across the desktop.
original: Gemini app on Mac can now do tasks on your computer, a top feature request!

rewrite: Google VP Josh Woodward 宣布，Mac 上的 Gemini app 现在可以直接在电脑上执行任务，这是用户反复要求的功能。变化很明确：Gemini 不再只是在 app 里回答，而是开始跨桌面行动。
original: Mac 上的 Gemini app 现在可以在你的电脑上执行任务，这是用户最希望看到的功能之一。

sections.title: Safety Moves Closer to Home / 安全问题走进家庭
sections.desc: 当攻击、冒充和克隆声音进入日常通信，安全产品要保护的已不只是企业账号。

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari asks who is securing elderly people as network attacks and impersonation attempts increase. He sketches four layers: a secure browser, a network-level device or VPN, payment screening, and a phone that filters calls and detects cloned voices. The buyer may be the adult child, potentially bundled with insurance.
original: As these network attacks and impersonation attempts happen, who's securing the elderly?
There are four layers I can think through where this could work.

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari 在问：当网络攻击和冒充越来越多，谁来保护老人？他列了四层可能的防线：安全浏览器、网络层设备或 VPN、付款前拦截，以及能过滤来电并识别克隆声音的手机。真正的买家可能是子女，甚至可以和保险打包。
original: 当网络攻击和冒充发生时，谁在保护老人？
我能想到四个可能的层级。

sections.title: The Physical Bottleneck / 物理世界的瓶颈
sections.desc: 数字世界跑得再快，实验、制造和算力基础设施仍然要落到真实的机器上。

cards.authorTag: CEO and Co-Founder of Arda · former OpenAI Chief Research Officer

rewrite: Bob McGrew's central argument is that superintelligence cannot arrive through the digital world alone: the scarce complement to cheap intelligence is physical capacity. Automating researchers can create a large one-time acceleration, but experiments still need GPUs, wet labs, machines, and manufacturing. If data centers need bulldozers, building the bulldozer factory itself also needs bulldozers.
original: I don't think you are actually gonna be able to get to superintelligence without changes in the physical world.
At the end of the day, you have to run the experiments.

rewrite: Bob McGrew 的核心判断是：超级智能不可能只靠数字世界抵达，便宜的 intelligence 对应的稀缺互补品是物理能力。自动化研究员可以带来一次很大的加速，但实验仍然需要 GPU、wet lab、机器和制造能力。如果数据中心缺 bulldozer，那么建 bulldozer 工厂本身也需要 bulldozer。
original: 我不认为你能在物理世界不发生变化的情况下抵达超级智能。
归根结底，你还是必须运行实验。

rewrite: OpenClaw maintainer Peter Steinberger says he landed a fix for an issue affecting users of the embedded harness rather than Codex. Most harnesses are not updated yet, so check which execution harness your setup is using before assuming the fix applies.
original: Landed a fix for that in OpenClaw yesterday (for the few folks using the embedded harness instead of codex, since it’s a plugin), most harnesses aren’t updated yet.

rewrite: OpenClaw 维护者 Peter Steinberger 表示，他已经修复了一个影响 embedded harness 用户的问题。由于 Codex 是 plugin，大多数 harness 还没有更新，所以要先确认自己的环境到底在用哪个执行 harness，再判断这个修复是否已经生效。
original: 我昨天已经在 OpenClaw 里修了这个问题，针对的是少数使用 embedded harness 而不是 Codex 的人；大多数 harness 还没更新。
